title: Test flight of the sport model, with a VHF radio link and light bending

tellings.quote: Anyway, shortly after the craft began to lift off the ground silently at a little corona discharge glow on the bottom

plain: Around 1988 or 1989, at a secret site in Nevada called S-4, a man named Bob Lazar says he watched a test flight of a craft he calls the sport model: it rose off the ground in silence, with "a little corona discharge glow", a faint electric glow, on its underside. He also describes a VHF radio link, a common band of radio used to talk with the craft, and the way the craft seemed to bend light around it. Lazar tells Michels this as something he saw himself, naming others present, Dennis Mariani and a man called Barry, and if true it would mean the government held and flew a craft not of human make.
